ns2:course.label: Advertising Management Plan
ns2:course.description: Application of analytical planning concepts to advertising planning and decision making; covers all of the decision making areas of advertising. 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: ADV 281.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: ADV 281.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Advertising major(s). Restricted to students with Junior, Senior, or Graduate class standing.
